description: Create, diagnose, refine, and adapt concise, tool-specific prompts using structured intent extraction, routing, safety checks, and reusable prompt templates.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool. Identify the target tool, ask only essential clarifying questions, and give me one concise, ready-to-paste prompt.
interface.longDescription: A prompt engineering workflow adapted from nidhinjs/prompt-master. It identifies the target AI tool, extracts the task and constraints, chooses an appropriate prompt structure, removes ambiguity and unsafe instructions, and delivers a ready-to-paste prompt. Includes tool-routing guidance, reusable templates, a 37-pattern diagnostic reference, and memory/context handling.

name: prompt-master
